blocks.instructionalPurpose: Sustained reading with words explained in context. Learner action: On the supplied outline map, trace each county boundary and match its number to the key. Distinguish the county area from its administrative capital name.

accessibility.textAlternative: County-capital key for the geographic map. Bomi: Tubmanburg. Bong: Gbarnga. Gbarpolu: Bopolu. Grand Bassa: Buchanan. Grand Cape Mount: Robertsport. Grand Gedeh: Zwedru. Grand Kru: Barclayville. Lofa: Voinjama. Margibi: Kakata. Maryland: Harper. Montserrado: Bensonville, also called Bentol. Nimba: Sanniquellie. River Cess: Cestos City. River Gee: Fish Town. Sinoe: Greenville.

accessibility.reducedMotion: Use the static text equivalent and record each model state on paper.
